profile.headline: Software Engineer at Centrifuge LLC
profile.summary:
Eric Harris is a very passionate and experienced Front End Developer. Using both his design and technical skills, he built and managed websites for a wide range of clients from marketing agencies to non-profit organizations. In 2012, shortly after receiving his associate degree in web design, Eric began working as webmaster for the American Humane Association. There, he took charge in finishing the redesign of websites for two of their leading programs as well as creating standards compliant email templates specifically for their Content Management System. He also recovered a database with over 2,000 movie reviews by their Film and TV unit program, which were thought to have been lost for years.

Eric is a very quick learner who adapts easily to the needs of his coworkers. He has experience with working under tight deadlines.

projects.title: Kingdom Hearts Insider Redesign
projects.description: Redesigning a fan community for a video game franchise with a few friends. Using bootstrap and various other opensource tools to create a more sustainable community website. Some big changes are responsiveness, more refined brand, and easier navigation of content databases.

projects.title: Collective Falulzcy {Currently on Hold}
projects.description: Member of web design team designing and developing a dynamic website for a video game startup. The site includes various jQuery elements (slideshow, filtered gallery), as well as a parallax, single page scrolling user experience.
